scope: Recorded mathematical commands and preserved development probes; ordinary file reads and packaging operations are not research experiments.

controlled_stops.reason: Wide initial interval evaluation was superseded by a folded contour with prepartitioned horizontal pieces; the latter produced a verified integer count 2028 for character 2 through 2000 in the retained partitioned2000-2 run. Parent runners remain to record each stopped child.

corrections: The first retained-evidence verifier used the human-readable broad estimate strings to reproduce candidates. Arb rounds these strings outward; three lower-height cases gained extra candidates. The corrected verifier reconstructs the tighter enclosure from recorded pole/gamma/zero terms and explicit error allowances. No recovery output or producer computation changed.
Unseeded wide interval evaluations at height 2000 were stopped after a 64-segment seeded folded contour succeeded. All four stopped processes were task-owned and their receipts ended with SIGTERM.

The initial held-out factor_list(expression, modulus=p) route failed when sorting FLINT modular coefficients. Poly(..., modulus=p).factor_list() avoids that expression-sort conversion and factors are multiplied back.
The 224-bit Riemann replay uses 90-digit mpmath values because the 60-digit comparison in the 160-bit producer would be too coarse for a new 224-bit root enclosure.
The float64 resolution probe is a planning experiment only; all coefficient claims use interval arithmetic. Preliminary budget counts differ from realized singleton counts and are not guarantees.
A preparatory git rev-parse was issued outside the checkout, returned not-a-repository, and was corrected by supplying the checkout cwd. It is not one of the recorded mathematical commands.
noncircularity: Decoder output hashes predate polynomial validation; the decoder uses no actual nuisance coefficients or prime partial sum in its moment bound.
inconclusive_control: Omitting the discriminant term has zero exclusions on this width grid; all 455 cases remain inconclusive.
